question: Which article of the Indian Constitution specifies Hindi as official language of the Union?
solution:
The correct answer is __Article 343.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Article 343

 
 
• Article 343 of the Indian Constitution recognizes Hindi in Devanagari script as the Official Language of the Union
 
• Article 343 or 343 (1) refers to Hindi as the official language of the Government of India and the script used for it is the Devanagari script.
 
• Devanagari's script is based on the ancient Brahmi script.
 
• It uses 47 characters of which 14 are vowels and 33 are consonants.
 
• Apart from Hindi, there are other languages like Marathi, Nepali, Bhojpuri, Rajasthani, Brajbasha etc which use the Devanagari script.
 
• It is mainly found in the Indian Subcontinent.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 344

 
 
• Article 344 States about the Commission and committee of the parliament in the official language.
 
 
 
• ​​Article 344(1)
 
 
• It provides for the constitution of a Commission by the President, consisting of a Chairperson and other members representing the different languages specified in the Eighth Schedule, to make recommendations to the President for the progressive use of Hindi for the official purposes of the Union.
 
 
 
• According to Article 344 of the Constitution, the first Official Language Commission was constituted in 1955.
 
• by Dr Rajendra Prasad (President of India)
 
• B. G. Kher became the chairperson of the Official language commission.
